NOTE: The PREVIEW-mode E2E flow (mounting the AnchorPreview overlay, second-tap CTA, done-gating, replace flow) COULD NOT be exercised live because headless Chromium in this container cannot decode the H264 test mp4 — ms-video reports error.code=4 (MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED), duration=NaN, videoWidth=0. Without a playable video, runAutoSuggest cannot produce suggested anchors and goToPreview's await runAutoSuggest() never reaches setStudioMode('PREVIEW'). This is a pure test-environment codec limitation, NOT a code defect.

minor.issue: 5 tests fail with FileNotFoundError: 'ffmpeg' — missing binary in this preview env. Not a code regression; same suites passed in iter19 when ffmpeg was installed. Install via: apt-get install -y ffmpeg.

action_items: Install ffmpeg in the preview container: `apt-get update && apt-get install -y ffmpeg` — required so that the 5 video-frame-extraction tests (verify_and_pick_thumbnail, audio_events, extract_frame_at) can run. This is the SAME issue iter19's tester didn't see because ffmpeg was already installed then.

To E2E-test the new PREVIEW mode (Trust-Stack #3 & #4) you need a video clip that Chromium-headless in this container can decode (e.g. a small VP8/VP9 .webm — H264 mp4 fails with MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED here). Consider committing a tiny webm test fixture to /app/frontend/public/test-fixtures/ so future iterations can stop relying on external clip downloads.

Optional follow-up — runAutoSuggest at /app/frontend/src/components/MarkerStudio.jsx:814 silently returns when v.duration < 2. Suggest also surfacing a toast when v.duration is NaN (currently NaN<2 is false so we proceed into MediaPipe but with a 0x0 canvas — could fail in confusing ways). Low-priority because real users never see this state.
critical_code_review_comments: MarkerStudio.jsx now 2148 lines (was ~1500 in iter19). With the addition of multiPoseRef state, goToPreview, handlePreviewReplace, handlePreviewSecondTap, runEnrollmentInBackground, and the rewritten runAutoSuggest, this file urgently needs to be split per the iter18/iter19 review comments. Extract: useRosterScan hook, useMultiPoseEnrollment hook, useAutoSuggest hook, separate AnchorOverlay component, separate ModeBar component. Current size makes regressions hard to spot.

goToPreview (MarkerStudio.jsx:1253) correctly guards autoSuggesting + missing video, but the dependency array on line 1269 deliberately omits runAutoSuggest with the comment 'stable via closure' — note that runAutoSuggest is NOT useCallback-wrapped, so each render creates a new closure. Capturing the first render's closure may miss state updates (anchors, multiPoseRef). Recommend wrapping runAutoSuggest in useCallback or hoisting it into the same useCallback as goToPreview to be safe.

AnchorPreview.jsx line 301 — `sorted.length - greenCount - yellowCount + yellowCount` collapses to `sorted.length - greenCount`. The redundant ±yellowCount looks like leftover refactor noise; clean up for readability.
spatioTemporal.test.js — 10/10 pass and cover the documented confidence bands + 8 m/s rule. Solid coverage for a pure-logic module. ✓

AnchorPreview.jsx done button label & disabled-state logic (line 327: `disabled={!doneAllowed || enrolling}`) matches the spec — DONE gated until ≥3 green anchors. Could not exercise live (no playable video) but static inspection confirms wiring is correct.
Public PDF endpoint still appropriate for the marketing CTA — recommend HTTP Cache-Control header (re-raised from iter19, still applies).

context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL ENV NOTE for future iterations: this preview Chromium cannot play arbitrary H264 mp4 inside a blob URL (ms-video gets error.code=4 / duration=NaN / videoWidth=0). To E2E-test ANY marker-studio flow that depends on the <video> actually being ready (PREVIEW mode, enrollment indicator, auto-suggest, second-tap CTA, replace flow), the test must feed a Chromium-compatible clip — recommended: a tiny VP9/Opus .webm baked into /app/frontend/public/test-fixtures/. With such a fixture you can exercise: (1) ms-enroll-indicator briefly appearing after ms-add-anchor, (2) clicking ms-done-fullwidth → runAutoSuggest → ms-preview-overlay visible, (3) ms-preview-grid card count, (4) ms-preview-anchor-N + 'Your tap' label + ms-preview-replace-N for non-user anchors, (5) ms-preview-second-tap + ms-preview-take-second-tap when <3 green (most likely on synthetic clips), (6) ms-preview-done disabled with label 'Need ≥ 3 strong anchors (X/3)' and enabled only at ≥3 green, (7) ms-preview-back returning to MANUAL with anchors intact, (8) Replace flow not appending to anchors[]. All required data-testid attributes were CONFIRMED PRESENT in /app/frontend/src/components/marker-studio/AnchorPreview.jsx via static inspection — only their runtime mounting is unverified. Also: ffmpeg needs `apt-get install -y ffmpeg` before re-running backend regression. Iter19 backend regression went green because ffmpeg WAS installed then; iter20's preview env was rebuilt without it.
rca of the issue: No code bugs identified. Two environment limitations: (a) backend container missing ffmpeg binary → 5 video-frame tests cannot run; reproducible with `which ffmpeg` (empty); fix = install ffmpeg via apt; (b) headless Chromium codec gap → <video data-testid='ms-video'> fails to decode the test BBB H264 mp4, blocking the runtime PREVIEW E2E path. Reproduce: open studio, inspect document.querySelector('[data-testid=ms-video]').error.code → 4. Mitigation = use a VP9 webm fixture. Both limitations apply only to automated testing, NOT to real users on real browsers.
